title: 500 Million Yuan Raised in Half a Year! Xihu Robotics Bets on the Surge of Embodied Intelligence

content_html:
As the first major technology transfer project in the fields of artificial intelligence and robotics at Westlake University, Westlake Robotics has recently seen dual acceleration from capital and technology. Within just six months, the company has completed four rounds of financing, with a total amount reaching 500 million Chinese yuan. The latest round, Series A financing, was led by Haiyuan Capital with nearly 100 million yuan raised. The funds will mainly be invested in the research and development of a unified large model for humanoid robots, as well as the construction of a talent cultivation base.

Under the leadership of its founder, Professor Wang Donglin, a lifetime professor at Westlake University, and co-founder Zhang Yue, the core team has gathered outstanding talents from top companies and universities. The company adheres to a full-stack self-research and development technology route, aiming to connect the three core components of embodied AGI. Currently, Westlake Robotics has launched its original self-developed GAE "Avatar" system, which has completed adaptation verification for multiple bipedal humanoid robots and has also initiated joint deployment with several leading manufacturers.

At the beginning of this year, the humanoid robot "Westlake o1," equipped with the GAE system, was officially launched. It possesses excellent autonomous movement decision-making capabilities. In terms of hardware, the robot uses self-developed joints, folding, and modular design, allowing it to flexibly adapt to various application scenarios. With solid technical capabilities, the company has established deep cooperation with industry giants such as Alibaba and Intel, securing orders worth nearly 100 million yuan. Its business scope covers areas such as scientific research and teaching. In the future, Westlake Robotics will also collaborate with the Longyou government to build a training base and plans to gradually expand its mature solutions to broader scenarios such as high-risk industrial inspections.

content_html_zh:
作为西湖大学人工智能和机器人领域首个重大技术转移项目，西湖机器人近期迎来了资本和技术的双重加速。 短短六个月内，公司已完成四轮融资，融资总额达5亿元人民币。 最新一轮A轮融资由海源资本领投，融资近亿元。 资金将主要投入仿人机器人统一大模型研发以及人才培养基地建设。

其核心团队在创始人西湖大学终身教授王东林教授和联合创始人张跃的带领下，聚集了来自顶尖企业和大学的优秀人才。 公司坚持全栈自主研发技术路线，旨在连接体现AGI的三大核心组件。 目前，西湖机器人已推出原创自研GAE“阿凡达”系统，已完成多款双足人形机器人的适配验证，并启动与多家领先厂商的联合部署。

今年年初，搭载GAE系统的人形机器人“Westlake o1”正式上市。 具有优秀的自主运动决策能力。 硬件方面，机器人采用自主研发的关节、折叠、模块化设计，使其能够灵活适应各种应用场景。 凭借扎实的技术能力，公司与阿里巴巴、英特尔等行业巨头建立了深度合作，获得订单近亿元。 业务范围涵盖科研、教学等领域。 未来，西湖机器人还将与龙游政府合作共建培训基地，并计划将成熟的解决方案逐步拓展到高风险工业巡检等更广泛的场景。
